goal: Prevent node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting disk space
Defer compaction when free disk space is insufficient and make compaction logging visible by default
agreement: General support for preventing compaction on low disk space (stickies-v, optout21, sedited, stringintech)
Contested objection: do not log a warning when skipping, since low-disk nodes cannot act on it (andrewtoth)
Unanswered suggestion to drop the release note (andrewtoth)
Open question on whether warnings should be more persistent for operators (stringintech)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by disk exhaustion during compaction
Directly resolves a reported bug affecting nodes running with tight disk margins
